title: wiz check --json, version 1
description: One JSON document written by `wiz check --json` (and `wiz build --json`), described in docs/check-json.md. Compatibility: fields may be added in version 1; never change the meaning of an existing field without a version bump. Removing a field, changing its type, changing the diagnostic sort order, or changing offsets from Unicode scalar values is version 2. Consumers ignore fields they do not know.

version.description: The format version. This schema is version 1.

command.description: The command that wrote the document.

tool.description: The toolchain that wrote the document.

commit.description: The release commit, or null in a checkout (where the toolchain has no REVISION file).

files.description: The files named on the command line, in that order, as written (not resolved).

ok.description: True when no diagnostic has severity error.

diagnostics.description: The messages, sorted by (span.file, span.start, code), then span.end and message.

artifacts.description: The files build wrote; always empty for check (it is present in both, so the shape does not depend on the command).

span.description: A place in a source file. start and end are zero-based character offsets (Unicode scalar values, not UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 code units); end >= start and may equal start for a point. line and col are the one-based line and column of start, also counting characters.

code.description: A stable error code from docs/error-codes.md, or null when the message has none.

related.description: Related locations, like LSP relatedInformation. Always empty in version 1: publishDiagnostics sends none yet. Reserved for additive use.

notes.description: Extra notes. Always empty in version 1: hints are part of message. Reserved for additive use.

data.description: The quick-fix payload the language server puts in a diagnostic (for example name and suggestions), or null when there is none.

fixes.description: Code actions for this message's span, computed by the same code that answers textDocument/codeAction (quick fixes, and refactors such as filling a hole). Empty for a message without a code.

span.description: The range to replace; start == end is an insertion.
